observing.naked_eye: At a dark site it can be glimpsed unaided as a tiny diffuse point, especially with averted vision.
observing.binoculars: Appears as a compact, round glow with a brighter center; steady binocular support improves detection. The field lies within the Almanack's visible Milky Way boundary, so the background is especially star-rich.
observing.telescope: Moderate to high power concentrates the core and, with sufficient aperture and good seeing, begins to resolve stars around the outskirts.
